subject: Post-call recap: Spectra AI evaluation & proposed action plan
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@spectra.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: Spectra AI evaluation & proposed action plan

Samir — thanks again for taking the time today. Brief recap and proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) below so we have alignment and clear next steps. Please reply with any edits.

Key pain points you called out:
- Latency spikes on your real-time classification pipeline during traffic bursts (p95 > 700ms).
- Unit compute cost for embeddings pipeline is higher than expected — goal is a 2-3x reduction.
- Security/compliance: procurement requires SOC2 evidence and audit log retention policies.

Goals you shared:
- Pilot in production for realtime classification (subset of traffic) by end of Q3.
- Reduce per-request cost of embeddings by at least 50% on steady-state.
- Clear procurement and security sign-off to move to Dedicated or Private deployment.

Stakeholders we noted:
- Samir Patel (Head of Data) — evaluation lead
- Laura Kim (VP Engineering) — final technical sign-off
- Ellen Moore (Procurement) — contract & procurement
- Jordan Blake (Redwood Solutions Engineer) — technical owner from Redwood
- Marissa Cole (Redwood CS) — pilot success owner

Proposed MAP (milestones, owners, target dates):
1) Technical deep-dive (env + perf): Redwood + Spectra engineering — Jordan, Laura — target: 2028-07-26
2) Pilot config & sizing (Dedicated capacity + quantization trial): Jordan + Samir — target: 2028-08-02
3) Security package & SOC2 docs delivered: Redwood (Marissa) -> Spectra procurement — target: 2028-07-28 (docs attached)
4) Pilot in production (limited traffic): Spectra + Redwood ops — target: 2028-09-15
5) Commercial decision / procurement sign-off: Spectra procurement & exec — target: 2028-10-01

Attached: spectra_mpa_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones and owners), redwood_security_brief.pdf (SOC2 summary + audit log retention). I also linked a HubSpot deal for reference.

Open items / asks for Spectra:
- Confirm the two technical attendees for the deep-dive (suggested: Laura + one backend engineer).
- Procurement contact (Ellen listed in the calendar invite — confirm preferred contract terms: PO vs. Master Service Agreement).
- Any additional constraints on data residency or HSM/KMS requirements.

If that aligns, I’ll lock calendar invites and send an updated MAP workbook next week.

Thanks —
Irene

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Spectra AI evaluation & proposed action plan

Irene — thanks for the clear recap. This is helpful. A few quick points / confirmations:

1) Attendees for the technical deep-dive: Laura Kim (VP Eng) and Rahul Desai (Senior Backend Eng) — Rahul will own instrumentation and perf vectors. Put the session on the 26th at 10:00 PT and include a perf baseline deck if possible.

2) Procurement: Ellen Moore is the procurement lead and will review the SOC2 docs. Our standard is an MSA + SOW; we prefer Net 45 for initial pilots but can be flexible.

3) Data residency: Spectra needs EU data subsets to stay in EU for analytics pipelines; initial classification pilot can run in US region. We'll share specifics in the deep-dive.

4) Cost: appreciate that you called out quantization and batching options — please add a line to the MAP with expected cost delta for the pilot vs. production (rough numbers are fine).

One more ask: can you include an estimated support SLA for pilot (response target during business hours) and an option for an SLA uplift for Dedicated? Ellen — looping you to confirm procurement cadence.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Data, Spectra AI
samir.patel@spectra.ai

- Marissa: please upload the SOC2 Type II report and a short export guide for audit logs to the Drive folder linked in the MAP. If possible, prepare a 1-page summary that lists coverage dates and the auditor contact.
- Jordan: prepare the deep-dive agenda and a perf baseline checklist (what we need from Rahul to reproduce p95 spikes). I recommend a 60min session: 15m intros, 30m perf instrumentation and backlog walkthrough, 15m next-steps and pilot sizing.

I'll draft the MPA update and circulate the redlineable MSA + sample SOW after Marissa uploads SOC2. Our immediate next external-facing action is the technical deep-dive on 2028-07-26 at 10:00 PT.
